messages:
maya: heads-up — saw a spike in TTFT that looks decoder-bound on a subset of routes this morning. baseline latency fine yesterday. :eyes:
raul: any KV-cache changes deployed overnight?
tess: nothing targeted at cache. there was a kernel-selector tweak in staging -> prod at 02:10 UTC (rollout small). see deploy bot: infra-bot: deploy/redwood-runtime v3.4.7 to prod at 02:10 UTC
maya: okay that matches. spike shows TTFT up ~18% on long-context routes, decode time only up ~4% though — attribution looks off. suspect our breakdown is merging queue/kernel in the wrong bucket.
samir: can you paste the probe trace?
maya: pasted below (sanitized):
```
route=chat/long-context tid=0x7f8 cmd=generate seq=1 prequeue_ms=4 queue_ms=12 handoff_ms=2 kernel_ms=64 kv_ms=3 decode_ms=70 ttft_ms=82
route=chat/short-context tid=0x8a3 cmd=generate seq=1 prequeue_ms=5 queue_ms=9 handoff_ms=1 kernel_ms=18 kv_ms=1 decode_ms=20 ttft_ms=35
```
raul: interesting — decode_ms ~ kernel_ms in logs, but our metric exporter reports kernel_ms much lower. maybe exporter is sampling kernel spans incorrectly for CUDA offload case.
tess: we added lightweight sampling for kernel spans in agent v2 to reduce telemetry cost. might be dropping microkernel calls when batch size=1.
maya: we need token-level waterfall that separates: prequeue, queue, scheduling, kernel_total, kv_lookup, postproc. current exporter has kernel_cpu and kernel_gpu but not kernel_total.
samir: propose quick plan: 1) add kernel_total as aggregated span in tracer (PR draft: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/592) 2) emit per-token attrs with route tag for a 6-hour sampling window 3) dashboard panel for per-route TTFT vs kernel_total with percentile lines + hist heatmap
tess: +1. also add a sanity probe that compares trace kernel_total to perf counters (cuda profiler) for 1% of requests.
maya: for immediate debug can we run a replay of recent traces with full spans? I can trigger replay on the probe runner.
raul: go for it — run against canary stack. set env: TELEMETRY_FULL_SPANS=true and sampling_rate=0.1. watch disk/ingest.
infra-bot: job/replay-traces-3629990001 started by maya (canary stack). logs -> https://internal.logs/replay/3629990001
maya: started. will post initial dashboard snapshots in ~20m. if kernel_total > kernel_gpu by a lot that suggests missing kernel_cpu accounting.
tess: noted — also add a prom query we can drop into Grafana quickly: `sum by (route) (rate(kernel_total_ms_bucket[5m])) / sum by (route) (rate(ttft_ms_bucket[5m]))` but probably want p50/p95 rather than ratio.
samir: once we have token-level heatmaps we can slice by batch-size, route, and sequence-length. that should reveal if batcher heuristics caused more singletons.
maya: FYI I saw a bump in singletons on those routes coincident with rollout — could be scheduler choosing smaller batches due to new kernel selector thresholds.
raul: action items: tess -> PR to add kernel_total + sampling hook, samir -> dashboard panels and heatmap templates, maya -> run replay and collect traces, raul -> monitor ingest and rollback if telemetry causes overload.
tess: putting PR up now. tag @samir for dashboard json.
maya: thanks — will update thread after first replay snapshots. :thumbsup:
